name: gaze-local-web
description: Browser port of the gaze v1 head-pose engine, plus a local demo page. Shaped for the frontend GazeClassifier contract.

scripts.build: npm run assets && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.fe.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.engine.json
scripts.fixtures: cd .. && uv run python tools/export_config.py && uv run python tools/make_fixtures.py
